name: The Big Crunch & the Big Bounce

pages.title: The Big Crunch & the Big Bounce
pages.text: $(thing)The Big Crunch & the Big Bounce$()$(br2)Enough matter, or dark energy that decays, and the expansion stops and reverses: everything falls back into a crunch. Quantum geometry may refuse the singularity - at the Planck density gravity repels, and the crunch bounces into a new expansion.
